messages.subject: Error in parse(input, n = -1L)  when deploying
parts:
Hi,

I've been able to deploy the app before. All I've changed was a typo in a help-block. The local instance runs fine.

However, when deploying, i get:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...
Error in parse(input, n = -1L) : 
  <myWorkingDirectory>/requirements.R:3:15: unexpected ','
2: 
3: a = {"rugarch",
                 ^


It looks like it may have something to do with the packages required for this app? What do I do?

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error in parse(input, n = -1L) when deploying
parts:
Evan,

I am not sure what the the exact problem is here, but it from the looks of it, it seems there is a syntax error in your requirements.R file. Please keep in mind that all files in the application directory are uploaded and parsed when you call deployApp(), so they must not have any syntax errors. deployApp() by default uses the current working directory.

-Andy
